description: The grants document a configuration names as `grants`: who may read what. A mapping an auditor can read, kept as a file and not computed by a service.

apiVersion.description: The version of this document's shape, `truvity.github.io/audit-grants/v1`. Absent is the same; another value is refused, so that a later shape arrives by a version and not by a file that quietly means something else.

issuers.description: The token issuers trusted to say who a caller is. They live in this file, beside the rules, because a rule is only as safe as the issuers able to satisfy it.

audience.description: The audience a token from this issuer must carry.

url.description: The issuer's URL, as a token's `iss` claim names it.

presets.description: Grant presets, which read grants out of a claim's vocabulary rather than one value each. Only `access-roster` exists.

issuer.description: The issuer whose claims it reads.

rules.description: Rules mapping a claim value to a grant.

all_tenants.description: Every tenant. Without it, `tenants` names them.

from.description: RFC 3339. The earliest a record may have happened for the holders to read it. Unset is unbounded.

profiles.description: The profiles the holders may read.

tenants.description: The tenants the holders may read.

until.description: RFC 3339. The latest. Unset is unbounded.

issuer.description: The issuer whose token must carry the claim. Unset lets any trusted issuer satisfy it, which a deployment with more than one should not.

name.description: What the rule is for, as it is named in a refusal.

value.description: The value of the claim that this rule applies to.

title: audit grants
